inputs.resume_text:
KABIR MALHOTRA
PGP 2025-27 | Indian Institute of Management Calcutta | kabirm2027@email.iimcal.ac.in

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS
PGP, IIM Calcutta, 2025-27, CGPA 8.2/10 (Top 10% of batch)
B.Com (Hons), Shri Ram College of Commerce, 2025, 9.1/10 (Rank 3)
CAT 2024: 99.86 percentile

SUMMER INTERNSHIP
Bain & Company, New Delhi | Summer Associate | Apr - Jun 2026
- Market-entry assessment for a Japanese two-wheeler EV maker in India: sized the electric scooter market across 40 cities and built a city-prioritisation model on charging density and ownership cost
- Interviewed 35 dealers and 12 fleet operators; findings shifted the client's launch city list from Delhi NCR first to Pune and Bengaluru first
- Received Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)

CORPORATE INTERNSHIP
Kotak Mahindra Bank | Strategy Intern | May - Jul 2024
- Benchmarked 6 private banks' credit card rewards programs and recommended cutting 2 low-use reward categories

CASE COMPETITIONS
- National Winner, HUL L.I.M.E. Season 16 (2026): rural distribution of a premium detergent; 1 of 3 winners from 21,000 teams
- National Finalist, Flipkart WiRED 7.0 (2025)
- Campus Winner, ITC Interrobang Season 14 (2025)

POSITIONS OF RESPONSIBILITY
- Coordinator, Consult Club, IIM Calcutta: ran 12 case-prep sessions for 140 first-years
- General Secretary, Commerce Society, SRCC (2023-24): led a 30-member team; raised INR 8 lakh in sponsorship for the annual fest

EXTRACURRICULAR
- State-level chess player (Delhi, U-19)

candidate.name: Kabir
candidate.band_reason: The resume shows highly specific, quantified achievements with clear ownership across consulting, leadership and competitions.

claims.text: Market-entry assessment for a Japanese two-wheeler EV maker in India: sized the electric scooter market across 40 cities and built a city-prioritisation model on charging density and ownership cost
Interviewed 35 dealers and 12 fleet operators; findings shifted the client's launch city list from Delhi NCR first to Pune and Bengaluru first
Benchmarked 6 private banks' credit card rewards programs and recommended cutting 2 low-use reward categories
National Winner, HUL L.I.M.E. Season 16 (2026): rural distribution of a premium detergent; 1 of 3 winners from 21,000 teams
Coordinator, Consult Club, IIM Calcutta: ran 12 case-prep sessions for 140 first-years
General Secretary, Commerce Society, SRCC (2023-24): led a 30-member team; raised INR 8 lakh in sponsorship for the annual fest

plan.warmup_question: What is one idea from your MBA coursework that has proved useful outside the classroom?
plan.background_question: Walk me through your background: your studies and the experiences that led you to apply for this role.

slots.core_question: Tell me about the market-entry assessment you worked on at Bain for the Japanese electric two-wheeler maker.
slots.intent_private: Needs Kabir's specific analytical approach, personal decisions in sizing and city prioritisation, how the recommendation was reached, and what he would do differently now.
likely_probes: Which part of the analysis was personally yours?
What did you decide against when building the city-prioritisation model?
What would you do differently now in that assessment?

slots.core_question: What was the hardest part of leading the Commerce Society team while raising sponsorship for the annual fest?
slots.intent_private: Needs a concrete leadership situation, Kabir's own decisions, how he handled stakeholders and team execution, and how the INR 8 lakh result was measured.
likely_probes: What decision did you personally make when the sponsorship effort was not progressing?
How did you respond when a team member was not delivering?
What did the INR 8 lakh figure represent?

slots.core_question: Suppose a client has strong market-growth data but limited ability to execute; how would you decide whether to recommend entering that market?
slots.intent_private: Needs a structured consulting judgment that weighs market attractiveness against execution feasibility, identifies the most decision-relevant evidence, and explains the trade-off.
likely_probes: Why would you prioritise that approach over another?
When would that approach give you the wrong answer?
Where have you faced a similar trade-off in your own work?

slots.core_question: You have a PPO from Bain; what draws you to build your career in strategy and consulting?
slots.intent_private: Needs a reason grounded in Kabir's own Bain, banking or competition experience and a specific understanding of what a strategy and consulting role offers, rather than a generic interest.
likely_probes: Which part of your Bain experience most influenced that choice?
What would you want to do in consulting that your other experiences did not offer?
What other career paths are you considering?

plan.plan_notes: The plan prioritizes Kabir's high-impact Bain market-entry work, then tests leadership through a substantial team and sponsorship responsibility. The knowledge slot checks strategic judgment beyond the strong resume claims, while the final motivation slot explores his career choice despite already holding a Bain PPO.
